title: HS30097: Financial Institutions And Markets
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisites: NoneCourse ContentsNature and Role of the Financial System:
Arbitrage in the Financial markets, Financial Sector Reforms; Regulatory and
Promotional Institutions: Reserve Bank of India, Securities and Exchange Board
of India; Banking Institutions: Commercial Banks, Co-operative Banks; Non-bank
Financial Intermediaries and Statutory Financial Organizations: Small Savings
and Provident Funds, Insurance Companies, UTI and Mutual Funds, Non Banking
Financial Intermediaries, Public Deposits with Non Banking Companies, Non Bank
Statutory Financial Organizations; Financial Markets: Call Money Market,
Treasury Bills Market, Commercial Bills Market, Markets for Commercial Paper
and Certificate of Deposits, Discount Market, Markets for Financial Guarantees,
Government Securities Market, Industrial Securities Market, Markets for
Futures, Options and Other Financial Derivatives; International Dimensions of
Financial Markets: Foreign Exchange Market, Foreign Capital Flows; Interest
Rates : Theories of the Level and Structure of Interest Rates, Interest Rates
in India; Policy Developments in Indian Financial System.
